description: Encode source and optional config into a bounded pako: token. Optionally create a share URL for an explicitly supplied HTTP(S) baseUrl, without credentials or an existing fragment. Does not validate syntax or open the destination. The token is reversible and contains the source.

code.description: Mermaid source text. Syntax is not validated and nothing is rendered.

mermaidConfig.description: Optional Mermaid config as a JSON object string; stored as untrusted data, never applied here.

name: encode_mermaid_share
title: Encode Mermaid share state
